newsitem.title: UK: BFI down nine as Panamaxes ease.
newsitem.headline: BFI down nine as Panamaxes ease.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was down nine points on Tuesday to 1,353 points.

Generally easier conditions for Panamaxes have been seen with tonnage said to be available for mid-August for 54,000 heavy grain USGulf to Japan at $22.75 no combo, following a fixture by Dreyfus of Chinese tonnage in this position at $23.00 (some report $23.15) no combo.
In the Pacific the 1995-built Elaranta 73,238 dwt was fixed by Yukong delivery prompt Japan for a NoPac round at $10,000 daily, reckoned by brokers to be a slightly softer rate for such business.
Capers and Handy-sizes were broadly unchanged with the Baltic Handy index down five to 1,005 points.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was down five to 13 points and turnover totalled only 13 lots.
